history.summary: THIS IS A SIKH GURDWARA, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE. Gurdwara Chhevin Padshahi ('of the Sixth King', i.e. Guru Hargobind Sahib) stands in Basti Shaikh (Basti Sheikh) locality of Jalandhar city, at the spot where Guru Hargobind, the sixth Sikh Guru, met a respected Muslim holy man known as Sheikh Darvesh during his tour of the Doaba region. The two held a deep spiritual discussion; fearing Mughal reprisal after Guru Arjan's arrest and torture, the Sheikh blindfolded himself before meeting the Guru so he could swear before the Mughal authorities that he had not 'seen' him. The gurdwara now stands where Sheikh Darvesh lived and is cited as a symbol of interfaith harmony. Note: the geocoder also lists a 'Diwan Hall Gurudwara Chhevin Patshahi' on Shiv Puri Road, Hargobind Colony, Basti Sheikh - likely a hall within this same complex (verify); 'Charan Kanwal Sahib Patshahi Chhevin' on Kala Singha Road appears to be the same or adjacent shrine (verify). Exact construction date of the present building is not published.

name: Gurdwara Chhevin Padshahi
town_description: Jalandhar is a major city of Punjab's Doaba region, one of the state's oldest continuously inhabited cities, well connected by the Grand Trunk Road and the Delhi-Amritsar rail line. Basti Shaikh is a locality within Jalandhar city (PIN 144002), where this gurdwara stands near Hargobind Marg; Jalandhar City Junction is about 3-5 km away.

travel.airport: Adampur Airport (~35 km, domestic); Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport, Amritsar (~100 km) for international flights.
travel.railway: Jalandhar City Junction (~3-5 km); auto-rickshaw or e-rickshaw to Basti Shaikh, using Guru Hargobind Singh Ji Hospital as landmark.
travel.road: Jalandhar is on NH3/NH44; within the city, Basti Shaikh is reached via Hargobind Marg/Main Road, Shiv Puri Road or Kala Singha Road.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Guru Hargobind's Gurpurab for major congregations (crowded).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listings conflict: Justdial says 04:00 am-10:00 pm daily; another listing says 04:30 am-9:40 pm; a third gives 18:00-22:00 (verify). Cover your head and remove shoes before entering.
